sources.entry: Image2icon - Create and personalize icons from your pictures. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Image2Icon
summary.one_liner: Image2Icon is a macOS app for turning pictures into custom file and folder icons, with optional paid unlocks for templates and extra export formats.
use_cases: Personalizing macOS file and folder icons
Creating app icons for iOS, iPadOS, Apple Watch and Android
Generating favicons for web and mobile
Tagging folders with text or emoji icons
Removing image backgrounds before making an icon
Batch exporting icons in multiple formats
summary.what_it_does: Image2Icon lets you drop an image onto the app and then drag a file or folder onto it to apply the picture as that item's icon. Users can change icon template background colours, add text or emoji, and tune the picture. It can make icons from any file or folder, and can restore a file's default macOS icon. The page lists favicon, iOS and Android icon outputs, batch export, and background removal. It also supports macOS Shortcuts automation and is available in eight languages.
notable: Drag-and-drop icon application to files and folders
Free iOS and Android developer icon conversion features
caveats: Templates, background removal, favicon, Windows ico, iconset, jpg and png export require in-app purchases (page says everything costs $9.99)
Pro version features such as 30 retina icon templates and many export formats are paid
Page does not state a version number or OS requirement beyond Monterey for Shortcuts
